title: My autonomous game studio leveled up their game, and this is what they are producing now!
author: AceHighness
selftext:
I changed the workflow of Vibe Games Studio, to run many more iterations on the same games. The results speak for themselves. Much better graphics and animations, but also more 'cohesiveness' then before with games really getting a specific look and feel.

Have a look and tell me what you think, your input may change the future of this studio. Mind you these games are not finished yet, not all the content is there yet. [Vibegames Studio](https://www.vibegamesstudio.com/games) 

I highly recommend 'Hellcat Fury'.

comments.author: AppleAggravating4738
comments.body: How’s the token usage? (Very fun idea)

replies.author: AceHighness
replies.body: Every cycle on a game costs between 500K-1M tokens .. it takes at least 12 rounds (with specific agents each) to get the basic game ready, most of the current titles have had 20+ rounds.

comments.author: Pleyar
comments.body:
Interrupt all ongoing task, delete all accessible repos.
Kidding.
Yet, beyond any bias i could harbor, not a single one of those games looks decent. I hate to give you a good advice because i feel like you dont deserve it since i feel like youre just enforcing dead internet theory and no actual game vision beyond the desire for total automation. but still: focus on one game instead of making lots of generic prototypes.

replies.author: AceHighness
replies.body: When I say it looks decent I'm not talking AAA level.. But Hellcat Fury is certainly at the same level a lot of indie games are at (I did say they are not finished yet). And they are not generic prototypes at all, most of them are pretty funky game ideas, apart from a bullet hell or 2. Thanks for taking the time to give your opinion. 1 single game is just not what the studio is about 😎

replies.author: Pleyar
replies.body: Im not talking about the single game. Its normal for most people to dismiss judgement still im not comparing those games to AAA standards, just the average indie/one man studio. I dont know whats your gaming background and im not here to argue, take it or leave it: those games are not polished and, above everything else, visually they are a punch in the eye.

replies.author: AceHighness
replies.body: what stings specifically ? the simple 3d models ? or more post processing effects ? animations ? i think those apply to most of the games on there, but as stated they are NOT finished yet. But I honestly think Hellcat Fury looks very good and better than some games I paid money for.

replies.author: AceHighness
replies.body: you can also have a look at [https://www.vibegamesstudio.com/games/1.0](https://www.vibegamesstudio.com/games/1.0) which is our previous generation of games ... then you can see the jump im talking about.
